press.P9a.interval_km.note: value = KM share of strokes followed by an in-clip pause (> 1.5 x period) on the KM's observed support (complete intervals; censored at the clip end and at MISSING). The KM mass beyond the last complete interval (P(T > pause_lo) = 0.235339) has no observed duration and goes to the ASSUMED long-stop process (W-W3); long intervals include detector misses

press.P9a.stroke_impulse_s.note: full width at half maximum of the mean |flow_v| profile in +-0.8 s around the train strokes (ROI-mean flow, not the ram travel itself); NOT RESOLVED: the width reaches the window (the ROI moves through the whole cycle), so this is a lower bound of a near-continuous motion, not an impulse
